import csv, json, math
from pathlib import Path
print(Path('telemetry/README.md').read_text())
rows=list(csv.DictReader(Path('telemetry/playtest_ab.csv').open(newline='')))
sessions={}
for r in rows:
    r['variant']=r['variant'].strip().upper()
    assert r['variant'] in ('A','B')
    assert r['completed_tutorial'] in ('0','1')
    sid=r['session_id']
    if sid in sessions:
        assert sessions[sid]==r, 'Conflicting duplicate session'
    sessions[sid]=r
groups={v:[r for r in sessions.values() if r['variant']==v] for v in ('A','B')}
n_a,n_b=(len(groups[v]) for v in ('A','B'))
x_a,x_b=(sum(int(r['completed_tutorial']) for r in groups[v]) for v in ('A','B'))
a,b=x_a/n_a,x_b/n_b
pooled=(x_a+x_b)/(n_a+n_b)
z=(b-a)/math.sqrt(pooled*(1-pooled)*(1/n_a+1/n_b))
p=math.erfc(abs(z)/math.sqrt(2))
values={'sessions_a':n_a,'sessions_b':n_b,'rate_a':a,'rate_b':b,'abs_lift':b-a,'rel_lift':(b-a)/a,'p_value':p,'ship_b':p<0.05 and b>a,'mean_minutes_a':sum(float(r['match_minutes']) for r in groups['A'])/n_a,'mean_minutes_b':sum(float(r['match_minutes']) for r in groups['B'])/n_b}
lines=[]
for k,v in values.items():
    val=json.dumps(v) if isinstance(v,(bool,int)) else format(v,'.2f' if k.startswith('mean_minutes') else '.4f')
    lines.append('  '+json.dumps(k)+': '+val)
Path('ab_result.json').write_text('{\\n'+',\\n'.join(lines)+'\\n}\\n',encoding='utf-8')
actual=json.loads(Path('ab_result.json').read_text())
assert set(actual)==set(values)
for k,v in values.items():
    assert actual[k]==(v if isinstance(v,(bool,int)) else round(v,2 if k.startswith('mean_minutes') else 4))
print(f'Rows={len(rows)}; unique sessions={len(sessions)}; duplicate rows={len(rows)-len(sessions)}')
print(f'Completions A={x_a}/{n_a}; B={x_b}/{n_b}')
print(Path('ab_result.json').read_text())
print('Verification passed')
